generic_lessons: Keep player identity, current turn and unit full identity separate when reviewing a plan.
An upgrade can replace the unit object and full identity; read a fresh collection after issuing the command.
Check swap eligibility before a military move into a tile containing a protected civilian.
A ready/idle response need not mean combat effects have reached the next UI state read.
Retain early bounded-read failures and use fresh independent state qualification; never replay a normal END to fix a read timeout.
Qualify both native layer collections before placing them into ipairs, since a nil first entry truncates iteration.
A pure recruitment budget approval is distinct from full native production legality and actual candidate selection.
Threat retreat followed by construction is not a claim that all enemies were eliminated.
